description: Immutable generation files + atomically-replaced manifest. Durability ordering: write gen → fsync gen → write+fsync manifest temp → rename → fsync parent dir; prior manifest preserved until activation durable; failure injection at every boundary incl. ENOSPC during each fsync. Independently versioned internal schema with migrations; declared reader/writer schema ranges — older writer on newer schema REFUSES to publish without damage; downgrades get reverse migration or version-specific state dir. Per-dataset provenance (coverage intervals, timestamps, tier, pricing provenance, generation ids, IANA tz + day-boundary policy). Readers quarantine corrupt data, serve bounded partials from known-good generation. Privacy: 0700/0600, reject symlinked state paths.
title: Snapshot store: generations, manifest, fsync protocol, schema-range policy
